args.query:
INSERT INTO cohort_summary (cohort, cohort_size, representative_comment, representative_id)
SELECT 
    cohort,
    COUNT(*) as cohort_size,
    contact_notes as representative_comment,
    participant_id as representative_id
FROM participants
GROUP BY cohort, contact_notes, participant_id
HAVING participant_id = (
    SELECT participant_id 
    FROM participants p2 
    WHERE p2.cohort = participants.cohort 
    AND p2.contact_notes = participants.contact_notes 
    AND p2.contact_notes IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY participant_id ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    cohort,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE contact_notes IS NOT NULL) as cohort_size,
    NULL as representative_comment,
    NULL as representative_id
FROM participants
GROUP BY cohort
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE contact_notes IS NULL) > 0
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cohort_summary cs 
    WHERE cs.cohort = participants.cohort 
    AND cs.representative_comment IS NOT NULL
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM participants p3 
    WHERE p3.cohort = participants.cohort 
    AND p3.contact_notes IS NOT NULL
);
